packages.name: xws
packages.description: X Window System (X11) core protocol and extension definitions
packages.note: Counterpart to wayland-protocol: the X11 protocol headers and specification documents (xorgproto). Nothing in the tree consumes these headers. kernel/kernel/x11_server.c implements a partial in-kernel X11 server with its own local opcode table in x11_server.h and does not include them, and there is no X client in the tree to connect. Listed so GUI packages have real 'x11'/'xorg' capabilities to depend on.
